noncomputable def VTask.extend {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} {γ : Sort u_3} (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (j : β → γ) : β → γ :=
  fun b =>
    if h : ∃ (a : α), f a = b then
      -- If b is in the image of f, use classical choice to get a preimage a
      let a : α := Classical.choose h
      -- Use g(a) as the value
      g a
    else
      -- If b is not in the image of f, use the fallback function j
      j b
